answer: A farm running 66 keys cannot self-supply these, since each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the tundra graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash. Since the tide escrow holds both sides, recruiting real counterparties is the operator's cost, and the nadir audit releases each pair. Admission needs 2 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
